metadata.title: COSU Front-Desk / Service Counter Endpoint SSPP
metadata.remarks: System Security and Privacy Plan defining Corporate-Owned Single-Use (COSU) Front‑Desk and Service Counter Terminals as shared, role-bound endpoint execution environments.

import-profile.remarks: Institutional security and privacy baseline profile.

system-characteristics.system-description: A corporate-owned, single-use endpoint supporting front-line institutional service workflows such as student services, registrar functions, library circulation, and IT service desks.

props.name: inherits-from-sspp
props.remarks: COSU Front‑Desk Terminals inherit foundational endpoint trust governance from the Secure Endpoint Platform SSPP.

props.name: endpoint-class
props.remarks: Single-use COSU endpoint for shared service counter workflows.

props.name: execution-model
props.remarks: Execution is restricted to approved line‑of‑business service applications and tightly scoped browser access.

props.name: user-authentication-model
props.remarks: Users authenticate with individual identities on a shared device; no persistent local profiles are retained.

props.name: ownership-model
props.remarks: Front‑Desk Terminals are owned by the institution.

props.name: management-model
props.remarks: Front‑Desk Terminals are centrally enrolled, configured, and monitored.

props.name: cryptographic-identity
props.remarks: Device identity is used for management, integrity verification, and network trust only.

props.name: baseline-hardening
props.remarks: Operating system configuration restricts general productivity tools, removable media, local storage, and unauthorized applications.

props.name: session-isolation
props.remarks: User sessions are isolated and cleared on logout to prevent cross-user data exposure.

props.name: network-access-model
props.remarks: Network access is limited to approved institutional service platforms, authentication services, and management endpoints.

props.name: data-persistence
props.remarks: Local storage of user or customer data is prohibited; all records reside in authorized backend systems.

props.name: eligible-data-classifications
props.remarks: Front‑Desk Terminals may participate in workflows involving Data Classification Levels 1 and 2 only.

props.name: non-equivalence-statement
props.remarks: Shared service counter usage does not imply eligibility for higher-classification data or privileged operations.

props.name: availability-requirement
props.remarks: Front‑Desk Terminals must prioritize availability and rapid recovery to support continuous service delivery.

props.name: monitoring-and-integrity-signals
props.remarks: Terminal health, configuration drift, and security-relevant events are continuously monitored.

props.name: lifecycle-governance
props.remarks: Front‑Desk Terminals support routine reset, periodic reimage, and auditable retirement workflows.

system-implementation.remarks: COSU Front‑Desk Terminals implement Secure Endpoint patterns with emphasis on shared‑use isolation, workflow integrity, and availability.

roles.title: Service Desk Operations
roles.remarks: Responsible for deployment, availability, and day-to-day operation of Front‑Desk Terminals.

roles.title: Administrative Governance Authority
roles.remarks: Approves business workflows, data access scope, and exception handling for Front‑Desk Terminals.

control-implementation.remarks: Front‑Desk Terminal implementations are OS‑specific and realized through kiosk modes, controlled user profiles, or hardened workstation configurations maintained as versioned artifacts.
